sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Viewer is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello, soldier. I've met some rookies recently, here in Tarkov. They say people don't watch everything on tape anymore, they watch it live! Programs, stories, and some even show their everyday life non-stop. They even said a bunch of civilians are watching Tarkov's activities live! It seems that the whole world is interested in our city! I don't understand how they organized the broadcast to the outside world, but I wouldn't mind a second pair of eyes. It's a simple task - organize surveillance in some spots, and I'll return the favor."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - This quest is only available to buyers of the "Edge of Darkness" edition of the game.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Install a WI-FI Camera on the mountain ledge on Woods
- Install a WI-FI Camera at the pier tower on Shoreline
- Install a WI-FI Camera at the office corridor on Factory

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- 65,000 EXP
- 400,000 Roubles
  - 420,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 460,000 Roubles with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 5× Bottle of Pevko Light beer
- 5× Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka
"I think I'm beginning to understand why people watch these "live streams". It's addictive!"

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Amount | Requirement | Notes |
| WI-FI Camera | 3 | Required | Can be purchased from Mechanic LL1. |
In this quest you have to place 1 WI-FI Camera each on Woods, Shoreline and Factory.

On Woods it has to be placed at a rock ledge with a tree on the mountain.

On Shoreline it has to be placed at the top of the lighthouse near the pier.

On Factory it has to be placed at the top of the office area stairs that are on the "Gate 3" extraction side, on the wall next to a broken chair. Note: Can not be completed at night at the current time.

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.text: The quest dialogue and success message are referencing the rapidly increasing popularity of the game on the streaming platform Twitch, likely directly relating to the first "Drops" campaign, which was available from December 30, 2019 till January 5, 2020.
